title: 知

sentences.imagePrompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: L224-S01 lesson image for a children's character-recognition app
Primary request: square image / 1:1 composition. A boy classmate realizes he did something wrong and willingly makes amends by tidying up his own messy classroom desk while the recurring teacher warmly encourages him nearby. The scene should clearly show knowing the mistake and improving as a good thing.
Visual cast: boy classmate with distinct short dark hair and simple school clothes; recurring teacher identity, adult teacher in tidy classroom clothing, calm instructional posture, visually distinct from protagonist mother and from the L058 adult woman.
Style instruction: Use the approved L058 lesson images only as style references: warm picture-book pencil-and-watercolor linework, soft natural light, detailed but clean classroom, expressive preschool proportions, bright warm palette, and phone-readable square composition. Do not copy any specific person from L058.
Composition: centered desk cleanup action, teacher and boy fully visible, safe margins, no crowd confusion.
Avoid: no text, numbers, labels, signs, blackboard writing, readable papers, logos, watermarks, harsh scolding, or shame.
sentences.imageNotes: 男孩同學做錯事後願意改過，正在把自己弄亂的桌子整理好，主角老師在旁邊溫和鼓勵。老師必須和主角媽媽視覺上不同。畫面要表現「知道錯、願意改」是好事；不可有文字、數字或標籤。

Visual cast: recurring protagonist mother in warm family role, white or beige top, wide blue pants, shoulder-length dark hair, distinct from teacher and passersby; recurring protagonist little girl if included, with small pink hair clip, pink outerwear, white top, blue skirt, pink shoes; baby is a separate infant identity, not a copy of the girl.
Style instruction: Use the approved L058 lesson images only as style references: warm picture-book pencil-and-watercolor linework, soft natural light, detailed but clean home, expressive preschool proportions, bright warm palette, and phone-readable square composition. Do not copy any specific person from L058.
Composition: mother and baby are the clear main focus, gentle home setting, safe margins.
Avoid: no text, numbers, labels, signs, readable book pages, logos, watermarks, or medical/hospital setting.
sentences.imageNotes: 主角媽媽抱著或照顧一個很小的嬰兒，嬰兒天真地看著周圍，表現小小孩還什麼都不知道。畫面可有主角小女孩在旁邊好奇看著，但主要人物是主角媽媽和嬰兒；不可有文字、數字或標籤。

sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩在安全的路邊或人行道上不知道怎麼走，向一位路人阿姨或路人叔叔問路。路人要使用 varied passerby identity，不可長得像主角媽媽或老師。畫面要有路、人行道、問路姿勢；不可有路牌文字、數字、地圖文字或標籤。

sentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩放學回家後，知道要換掉校服和校褲，主角媽媽在旁邊準備家居衣物。畫面只呈現準備更換衣物的安全情境，不呈現更衣過程；校服校褲不可有校名、文字、數字、徽章字樣或標籤。
